Measured there on 0.29.0, each budget is about 5% over: tool definitions 16542 bytes (17400), the first prompt 19419 (20400), the largest prompt 34916 (36700), the turn's input tokens 211749 (222400). Without those hosts (the umbrella's mix troupe.bench) the numbers are 14874, 17770, 33267 and 198977.
